findings.summary: The upstream_contract_repair defect (body-less POST without Content-Type -> 415 json_required) is already repaired in the current tree: request() sends Content-Type application/json and JSON.stringify(body ?? {}) for every POST/PUT/PATCH (httpClient.ts L11-13, L92-102). server/http/requestGuards.ts WRITE_METHODS is POST/PUT/PATCH only, so the body-less DELETE calls are unaffected. requireJsonWrites was not relaxed. No edit was made by this unit.

Capability-wide checks `pnpm test -- tests/unit/forbiddenTerms.test.ts` and `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/result.spec.ts` (AC-dm-28 e2e, AC-dm-29 rendered-text scan, AC-dm-46 390px/axe, AC-dm-47 reduced motion) were not run: those test files are outside this unit's allowed files and belong to integration.
